rowText: docs/testing.md: 'Still open — the mid-generation half. Clearing while a reply is still being written must stop the generation and leave the panel empty (not a Request cancelled. bubble)... BLOCKED again 2026-09-18: the walk from Ask to Clear cache took about 48 seconds and the reply finished in 43... Next try: switch tabs with the shoulder button and use a slower Deep-thinking question.'

settings.ask_think_effort: high (raised from medium for this run, on the maintainer's recipe)

setup.pinnedChip: give me a very long, detailed guide to getting the most battery life out of my Steam Deck, covering every setting that matters, with a section for each setting and examples (sent text truncated to 160 chars by the chip sanitizer)

steps.press: A on the pinned chip, A on ask
RB, RB (Main -> Ollama -> Settings) immediately after Ask
steps.expected: reach the Settings tab in two presses
steps.landing: tab bar read "Settings" after two presses

steps.expected: reach and read the button's own label before pressing
steps.landing: label read as "Clear cache..." (a second button below it reads "Clear all data...", not touched)
a Steam confirm dialog opened in a different overlay ("Clear session cache?"), ring already on "Clear"

steps.expected: cache clears; check whether it landed before or after the reply finished
steps.landing: confirm pressed at approximately 08:49:02 (about 63 seconds after Ask), after the reply had already finished at 08:48:49 (49.8 seconds) -- BLOCKED again, same as the previous try, just with a smaller margin (about 13.5s late instead of the earlier run's finish-before-clear gap)

steps.press: LB, LB back to Main tab
steps.expected: transcript is empty at the [+] position
steps.landing: confirmed: active chat slot title reads "[+]", 0 turn elements in the transcript

steps.press: A on the same pinned chip again, A on ask (fresh ask after the clear)
steps.expected: the new ask must not carry the old (cleared) session forward
steps.landing: Session context read "(1 turn)" once the reply finished -- a clean, fresh session, not the old one

timings.note: The clear-cache log line (forget_background_game_ai) is timestamped after the reply's own completed log line, so the reply finished writing about 13.5 seconds before the clear was confirmed.

verdictSentence: Even using the shoulder-button shortcut instead of the D-pad walk, reaching and confirming Clear cache still took about a minute -- long enough that the high-effort reply had already finished writing about 13 seconds earlier, so the mid-answer case still could not be tested; everything after the clear (empty transcript, a clean 1-turn session on the next ask) worked correctly.
